# Theme Test Spec Doc Entity

### Scope

- **Purpose**: Provide test coverage specifications for all theme doc instances.
- **Responsibility**: Registry and overview of all theme test spec instances.
- **In Scope**: TH-N theme test cases in Given/When/Then format for all 8 theme elements; minimum 4 cases per spec.
- **Out of Scope**: `ColorTheme`/`ColorThemeBuilder` API contract (see `../api/`), theme attribute schema (see `../data_structure/`), theme application mechanics across config types (see `../feature/`).
